developer-invitations.postOrgsByIdDevelo.description: Invites a developer by email. They get developer access with their own sandbox through a Polaris ID. Pass roles to also join the organization with them. Needs a session with members:manage and a recent sign-in, or a Live key naming members:write. Counts against the members.developers limit.

developer-invitations.getOrgsByIdDevelop.description: Lists pending developer invitations, plus those revoked or expired in the last 30 days.

developer-invitations.deleteOrgsByIdDeve.description: Revokes a pending developer invitation and the membership invitation paired with it.

developer-invitations.getOrgsByIdDevelop.description: Lists the developers the organization vouches for. available is false when the plan has no developer seats or Polaris ID cannot be reached.

developer-invitations.deleteOrgsByIdDeve.description: Ends the organization's developer sponsorship of a person and revokes the membership their invitation made. The answer is the same whether or not they were sponsored here.
